com.motomodsdev.mdkbattery.description:
MDK Battery is a simple app that shows charge level and status of your Moto Z and the Battery Personality card attached to your Reference Moto Mod. It provides an end-to-end example for how to interface with a Moto Mod that contains a battery.

For a detailed walk-through and details for this app, visit http://developer.motorola.com/build/examples/battery

This app requires a Moto Z, Reference Moto Mod, and Battery Personality Card. To purchase hardware, visit http://developer.motorola.com/buy

Note: This app is for development purposes.
com.motomodsdev.mdkbattery.title: MDK Battery - Apps on Google Play

com.motomodsdev.mdkdisplay.description:
MDK Display is a simple app that provides an end-to-end example of a Moto Mod that contains a display. This is accomplished via the Display Personality Card attached to your Reference Moto Mod. This app provides controls to turn on/off the Moto Mod display, and a way to test various sample modes such as rear camera selfie, clock, and presentation modes.

For a detailed walk-through and details for this app, visit http://developer.motorola.com/build/examples/display 

This app requires a Moto Z, Reference Moto Mod, and Display Personality Card. To purchase hardware, visit http://developer.motorola.com/buy

Note: This app is for development purposes.
com.motomodsdev.mdkdisplay.title: MDK Display - Apps on Google Play

com.motomodsdev.mdksensor.description:
MDK Sensor is a simple app that provides an end-to-end example demonstrating how to obtain readings from the Sensor Personality card attached to your Reference Moto Mod, which it then displays in the app as graph.

For a detailed walk-through and details for this app, visit http://developer.motorola.com/build/examples/sensor 

This app requires a Moto Z, Reference Moto Mod, and Sensor Personality Card. To purchase hardware, visit http://developer.motorola.com/buy

Note: This app is for development purposes.
